_doc: Style frames of the scheme stand (composition KakRabotaetClaudeScheme): 0 = scene 5 (stand, blinds closed), 1 = end of scene 6 (line 2 to «rabbit», coral), 2 = scene 7 mid (blind and clamp on their way), 3 = end of scene 7 («habit», coral), 4 = end of scene 8 («green», coral, «без рифмы»), 5 = inset of scene 9. Coral = the last written tile of the line (a lit moving part, drawn as a top face). still-check measures the frames that carry coral (1, 3, 4); frames 0 (scene 5), 2 (scene 7 mid, nothing is written yet) and 5 (inset) have no coral by design, so they are checked by motion-check only.
coralNote: coral is off ON PURPOSE: the coral part is one tile (≈ 100 × 34 px, 0.2 % of the band) and still-check's floor is 0.4 % (hard-coded); see docs/progress/kak-rabotaet-claude.md, request R4. Verified by eye on frames 1, 3, 4: one coral tile per frame.
